title: equisetum fluviatile var. linnaeanum
intro: Equisetum fluviatile var. linnaeanum, commonly known as Water Horsetail, is a perennial aquatic plant belonging to the Equisetaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering several health benefits such as reducing inflammation, promoting wound healing, and supporting urinary tract health. The therapeutic actions of Water Horsetail include diuretic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. Additionally, Water Horsetail has been found to have antioxidant and immunomodulatory effects, making it a potential natural remedy for various health conditions.
